categories.main_business_segments: Sichuan Kexin Mechanical and Electrical Equipment Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the manufacturing of high-end heavy process equipment, focusing on pressure vessels used in nuclear power, military, new energy, new materials, natural gas chemical, petroleum refining, and coal chemical industries. The company designs, develops, manufactures, and installs key core equipment such as reactors, heat exchangers, towers, and containers. It also engages in system integration services for these sectors.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced manufacturing technologies including multi-layer clamping, large thin-walled complex component forming, large spherical tank segment pressing, CNC bending, and specialized welding techniques for various steel types and special alloys. It holds numerous patents and certifications such as ASME U and U2 stamps and nuclear safety manufacturing licenses. Production methods include order-based manufacturing, with capabilities for on-site fabrication of oversized heavy equipment and extensive use of automated welding and digital manufacturing systems.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are large enterprises in the energy and chemical sectors including petroleum refining, natural gas chemical, coal chemical, nuclear power, new energy, and new materials industries. Major clients include China National Petroleum Corporation, Sinopec, China National Offshore Oil Corporation, China General Nuclear Power Group, and leading chemical companies like Wanhua Chemical. The company serves both domestic and international markets, with a strong presence in China and exports to countries such as Iran, Bangladesh, and Vietnam.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company is headquartered in Shifang City, Sichuan Province, China, and primarily serves the domestic Chinese market, which accounts for over 98% of its sales. It also has a smaller international footprint with exports accounting for about 1.7% of revenue. The company benefits from its location in Deyang, a major equipment manufacturing base in western China, and has strategic operations in Ningxia and other regions.
categories.supply_chain_position: Sichuan Kexin operates primarily in the midstream to downstream segments of the supply chain as a manufacturer and system integrator of specialized pressure vessel process equipment. It procures raw materials such as stainless steel, carbon steel, composite materials, and special alloys from upstream suppliers and delivers finished equipment directly to end customers in energy and chemical industries.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes continuous innovation in high-pressure, corrosion-resistant, extreme temperature-resistant, and special material equipment. R&D focuses include development of nuclear fuel transport containers, hydrogen energy equipment, solid-state hydrogen storage, and advanced welding technologies. It invests in digital transformation, intelligent manufacturing, and clean production, aiming to enhance product quality, efficiency, and environmental compliance. Collaboration with universities and research institutes supports its technology leadership.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of customized, order-based manufactured pressure vessel equipment and related system integration services. The company follows a payment model based on prepayments, progress payments, delivery payments, and quality assurance deposits. It also earns income from government subsidies and investment returns on financial assets.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes in a fragmented domestic and international pressure vessel manufacturing market dominated by established players from the US, Europe, Japan, Korea, and India. Sichuan Kexin is positioned as a leading domestic high-end pressure vessel manufacturer with strong technical capabilities, comprehensive certifications, and a growing market share. It is recognized for its advanced technology, quality assurance, and ability to supply large-scale and complex equipment, placing it among the top tier in China.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.22 billion, a decrease of 18.79% from the previous year, but net profit attributable to shareholders increased by 3.54% to about RMB 169 million. Total assets stood at RMB 2.35 billion with net assets of RMB 1.63 billion. The company maintains positive cash flow from operations and has shown steady profitability despite market fluctuations. It invests significantly in R&D, with expenditures around RMB 41.7 million, representing 3.43% of revenue.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Sichuan Kexin differentiates itself through its comprehensive qualifications, advanced manufacturing technologies, and strong R&D capabilities, enabling it to produce large, complex, and high-specification pressure vessels and process equipment. Its products meet stringent safety, quality, and environmental standards, including nuclear and military certifications. The company offers customized solutions with integrated services, emphasizing safety, quality, delivery, and cost control, which has earned it high customer satisfaction and a solid reputation in both domestic and international markets.
